annotation.title_clean: D1.2 Ethics Framework: Managing active and healthy aging with use of caring service robots
annotation.title_en: D1.2 Ethics Framework: Managing active and healthy aging with use of caring service robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Beyan, T.; Felzmann, H.; Ryan, M.; Lang, N.; Beyan, O.
annotation.venue: MARIO project (H2020 643808) deliverable; University of Twente repository
annotation.summary_en: Ethics framework deliverable for the EU H2020 MARIO project on care robots for older people with dementia. It reviews literature and care-robot ethics and builds a layered framework (care process, quality of care, functionalities, design features), then applies it to MARIO use cases, with attention to privacy, dignity, autonomy and responsibility.
key_provisions_or_claims: Multi-layered ethical framework: care integration, quality of care, robotic functionalities, design features
Care robots are double-edged, with both ethical risks and improvements
Data protection and privacy integrated into design
Humanoid morphology should be limited to what design objectives require
Framework applied to dementia-focused MARIO use case scenarios, with informed consent guidance for trials
